title: MNS
tagline: Simplify crypto on Mode blockchain and beyond with MNS – Mode Name Service. No more juggling addresses. Just one Mode Name for all your assets, tokens, and NFTs across EVM-compatible blockchains. Say goodbye to complexity!
description:
introducing the MODE Naming System, an innovative solution poised to revolutionize blockchain accessibility. In a landscape where complexity often hinders adoption, our project offers a simple yet powerful innovation.

Our focus is on the MODE blockchain. The challenge? Traditional EOA addresses are convoluted, limiting mainstream engagement. Our solution? Empowering users to attach personalized ".mode" name handles to their addresses. With this addition, transactions become as intuitive as email exchanges.

For this hackathon, we're showcasing the implementation of ".mode" handles, demonstrating real-world feasibility. Beyond this event, our vision extends to a Resolver SDK, enabling decentralized apps to integrate our user-centric approach.

We invite you to join our journey. By simplifying blockchain interaction, we're unlocking its potential for all. If you're excited about shaping a more user-friendly blockchain landscape, reach out to us. Let's reshape the future of blockchain together.
how_its_made:
The creation of the MODE Naming System has been a meticulous process, combining cutting-edge technologies to achieve a seamless and user-friendly solution. Here's an overview of how it all comes together:

• Name Handle System:

We developed a custom name handle system that allows users to associate ".mode" handles with their blockchain addresses.
This was achieved using a combination of smart contracts and off-chain databases to link user-provided names with their respective addresses.

• Smart Contracts:

We used Solidity to create smart contracts on the MODE blockchain.
These contracts manage the mapping between ".mode" handles and actual blockchain addresses, ensuring accurate resolution.

• Blockchain Integration:

Our project heavily leveraged the existing infrastructure of the MODE blockchain to ensure seamless integration.
Through the smart contracts, we enabled the ".mode" handles to be associated with specific addresses.

• Resolver SDK Development:

We crafted a Resolver SDK using modern programming languages like JavaScript and Python.
The SDK simplifies the integration of our solution into various decentralized applications, streamlining the process for developers.

• Decentralized Application Integration:

With our Resolver SDK, dApp developers can easily integrate the ".mode" handle resolution feature.
This integration enables dApps to seamlessly convert user-friendly ".mode" handles into blockchain addresses behind the scenes.

• User Interface:

We designed an intuitive and user-friendly interface that allows users to create and manage their ".mode" handles.
The interface communicates with the smart contracts on the blockchain to update and resolve handles.
